annotations.title: Dub audio: translated voice track in English or Spanish, plus subtitles

description: Dub a clip: speech in any of 90+ languages is transcribed, translated and spoken again as one MP3 in English or Spanish (Aura-2, pick a voice), with translated SRT on the original timings. MP3/WAV up to 10 minutes or other formats up to 2 MB, by URL or upload; up to 2,500 characters of new speech. The voice keeps the original order, not exact timing. Use for course clips, product videos and social posts in a second language. Example: url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/77/Tofino_pronunciation.mp3, to=es. Price $0.10/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

from.description: Spoken language of the recording (default: detected)

to.description: Language of the new voice: en or es

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the recording (MP3/WAV up to 10 minutes; M4A, OGG or WebM up to 2 MB); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)

voice.description: Aura-2 voice for the new track (default luna for en, aquila for es)
